title: A direct summand of a finite free module is finite locally free (standard cover)
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $M$ an $A$-module which is a direct summand of a finite free $A$-module (equivalently, $M$ is finite projective). Then there are finitely many elements $f_1,\dots,f_r\in A$ generating the unit ideal such that for every $i$ the localization $M_{f_i}$ is a finite free $A_{f_i}$-module.
